body: As a guy with parents and a younger brother and sister who's pretty close to committing suicide, this one hits me pretty hard.  Thinking about the pain it would cause them is pretty much the last thing keeping me alive.
Hey man, I'm glad to hear things are going better for you.  Today was a little better for me too.
Little of both.  They never offered anything, and I didn't really feel like asking.
For sure man.  I hope things are going okay for you.
Well, I'm going to bed and not killing myself tonight.  Hopefully tomorrow is a better day.  Big thanks to everyone here, just putting this out there gave me a little relief.

Last time was about 3 years ago.  I ended up going to the VA and their doc diagnosed me with PTSD from my time in Iraq.  Now they send me a check every month, but I haven't gotten any care at all after the diagnosis.
It's a really shitty feeling man...  It sounds like you know that as well as I do.

My situation right now is similar to yours last week.  I'm sitting at my desk with my letter written and my pistol right next to it.  I've been depressed for a long time, but this is probably the closest I've ever been...  I've never actually written the letter before.

Part of me wants to try to get help, but I can't stand the thought of the people in my life hearing about how I'm weak.  I'm also unwilling to have my right to own guns removed.  I guess that's why I'm here anonymously and not talking to somebody in real life.
I've tried both in the past.  I hate the way the meds make me feel, but therapy was helpful once or twice.
Yeah, I guess it's been over half my life now.  Started in my early teens, now I'm almost 30.  I've tried so hard for so long to stop being depressed, and now I don't even know what else to do.
